responsibility: This header defines the target-customizable interface for GCC's pair-fusion RTL pass. It declares the `base_cand` and `writeback_type` support types plus the `pair_fusion` virtual base class whose hooks decide which loads/stores to track, what operand modes and register classes are pairable, alias-check limits, writeback handling, offset-range legality, pair recognition/destructuring, and pattern generation for fused or promoted writeback pairs. It is the contract between the generic pair-fusion implementation and target back ends that want paired-memory-access optimization.
same_name_distinction: Defines the reusable target-facing contract for pair fusion, including `base_cand`, `writeback_type`, and the virtual `pair_fusion` hooks that describe target legality and pattern generation. In this same-name pair, the .cc is the generic pass implementation that consumes those hooks.
